title: GitHub - GitHub Enterprise Importer Maintenance
text:
Service: GitHub
Maintenance: GitHub Enterprise Importer Maintenance
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2022-10-05T04:00:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2022-10-05T05:00:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2022-10-05T05:00:40.126Z: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2022-10-05T04:00:48.521Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2022-09-29T14:04:44.529Z: scheduled - GitHub Enterprise Importer will be undergoing scheduled maintenance. During this time, all migrations will be paused. You will be able to queue new migrations, but they will not start until the end of the maintenance window.

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

GitHub Enterprise Importer will be undergoing scheduled maintenance. During this time, all migrations will be paused. You will be able to queue new migrations, but they will not start until the end of the maintenance window.
